name: Caterpillar
description: Caterpillar sells construction and mining machines, engines, generator sets, industrial gas turbines and locomotive components through independent dealers, and finances them through Cat Financial. Its biggest segment is no longer machines: Power & Energy (engines, generator sets, turbines and turbine services) was 48% of 2025 segment sales and 46% of segment profit, and is the one exposed to the data-center power buildout. Money comes from three sources: new equipment sold to dealers and end users, recurring parts and services on the installed fleet, and interest and lease income at Cat Financial. Order backlog was $51.2B at year-end 2025 versus $30.0B a year earlier, largest growth in Power & Energy. 2025 profit fell 15% because of about $1.0B of tariff costs, so Q2 2026 sales and revenues grew 24% year on year.

businessLines.name: Power & Energy
businessLines.how: Sells engines and turbines to power generation, oil and gas and data-center customers via dealers and direct; then earns recurring service and parts. Data-center prime-power orders are rising per the 10-K outlook.
businessLines.description: Reciprocating engines and generator sets, integrated systems, Solar Turbines gas turbines and turbine services, remanufacturing (oil and gas, power generation, marine, rail, industrial).

businessLines.name: Construction Industries
businessLines.how: Sells machines to dealers (who resell to contractors), then parts and services; price realization was negative $1,136M in 2025 as tariffs and competition weighed.
businessLines.description: Backhoe loaders, small and medium excavators, wheel loaders, compact track loaders, skid steers, dozers, motor graders and related parts, sold through dealers.

businessLines.name: Resource Industries
businessLines.how: Sells very large machines to miners and quarries via dealers and direct, then multi-year parts, service and autonomy; orders track mining capex and commodity prices.
businessLines.description: Large mining trucks, shovels, draglines, drills, underground mining equipment, tunnel boring, and equipment for quarrying and heavy construction.

operatingProfit.note: segment profit as reported (before corporate items and eliminations of -$2,189M in Machinery, Power & Energy and -$102M/-$597M in Financial Products and consolidating adjustments); share computed against the $14,039M sum of segments

businessLines.name: Financial Products (Cat Financial, Insurance Services)
businessLines.how: Earns interest and lease income on loans and leases to customers and dealers; profit is the spread over funding cost.
businessLines.description: Cat Financial provides retail and wholesale financing for Caterpillar products and dealers; Insurance Services offers property, casualty and life insurance.
